packageRules.description: Internal workspace packages are versioned by melos releases, not Renovate
fitbitter is a pinned fork (git ref master); skip automated updates
Native platform tooling (Android Gradle, iOS CocoaPods, fastlane Gemfiles) follows Flutter and platform defaults; update it with Flutter upgrades
Use chore(deps) commits for all updates (repo convention)
Group minor and patch updates into one PR
Major updates raise a separate PR marked as breaking
packageRules.groupName: major updates with breaking changes (review required)
prBodyNotes: This PR contains major (breaking) dependency updates. Review each dependency's changelog before merging.
Remove the `Do not merge` label when the updates are approved.
